title: cursor.com moved off its CMS to code in 3 days for about $260 of agent tokens
summary: Cursor's Lee Robinson used coding agents to migrate cursor.com from a headless CMS to raw code and Markdown, arguing the CMS hid content from agents that could otherwise edit the site directly.
agent_role: Agents rewrote content and pages across the repo; Robinson directed the migration, reviewed commits and handled the cutover.
outcome: Migration done in 3 days: 344 agent requests, 297M tokens, $260, 67 commits across 1023 files, zero site downtime

curation.rationale: Launch seed collection, researched from search results.
